verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਅਰੋਗ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau jananee khaan paan kau sa(n)jam karai taate sut rahai nirabighan arog jee ||

en.bdb: Just as a would-be mother takes care of what she eats so that the child in her womb remains healthy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚੈਤੰਨ ਰੂਪ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਿੰਤ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਬਸਤ ਲੋਗ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raajaneet reet chakravai chaita(n)n roop taa te nihachi(n)t nirabhai basat log jee ||

en.bdb: Just as a good ruler remains alert in the enforcement of law and order so as to keep his subjects safe, fearless of any harm and happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੰੁਚਤ ਪਥਿਕ ਅਸੋਗ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kareeaa samu(n)dhr bohith mai saavadhaan taa te paar paha(n)uchat pathik asog jee ||

en.bdb: Just as a sailor is ever alert while sailing his boat in the ocean so that he takes all his passengers safely to other shore.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਸਿਖ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਜੋਗ ਜੀ ॥੩੫੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur pooran braham giaan dhiaan liv taa(n) te niradhokh sikh nij padh jog jee ||354||

en.bdb: Similarly, the God-like True Guru is ever alert to bless his loving and devoted servant with knowledge and ability to focus his mind in Lord's name. And thus a Sikh of the Guru keeps himself free of all vices and becomes eligible for higher spiritual state. (354)
